# Risk register

Identified risks for the Example Ltd ticket ranking system.

| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Biased ranking of customer tickets | medium | medium | quarterly fairness review | Platform team |
| Prompt injection through ticket text | high | medium | input filter and monitoring | Security group |

Residual risk accepted by the head of platform on 2026-10-14.
